overall_goal: Transfer the dried mushrooms from their packet into a glass jug

goals.description: Set up the glass jug and open the packet of mushrooms
goals.rationale: The person places the jug on the worktop and then reads and tears open the packet of mushrooms.

goals.description: Empty the packet of mushrooms into the glass jug
goals.rationale: The person pours and shakes the packet to ensure all the mushrooms are transferred into the jug.

goals.description: Adjust the position of the glass jug on the countertop
goals.rationale: The person picks up, places down, shakes, and turns the glass jug to settle its contents and position it properly.
